name: plan-progress
description: A pane for a multi-step task: the goal, the phase, the checklist, a progress bar and the clock, plus every session's runs and a chime when a turn ends.

keepWarm.description: While the session sits idle, send a short prompt so the prompt cache does not go cold. Each one is a real turn and shows in the transcript.
keepWarm.title: Keep the cache warm

keepWarmMinutes.description: How long the session must be idle before a keep-warm turn is sent. Keep it under the cache TTL in minutes.
keepWarmMinutes.title: Idle minutes before a keep-warm turn

keepWarmText.default: Keep-warm ping. Nothing to do: answer with the single word ok.
keepWarmText.title: Keep-warm prompt
